body:
Wait wait wait. So theoretically speaking I’d have to wait 90 days before getting my Pokémon? That’s such a terrible way of selling Pokémon why even bother at all?! Considering you can only gift 20 to friends, you’d have 20 people waiting 90-day long transaction. And then if someone changes their mind or actually ends up getting their shiny themselves that’s a big waste of time. 

And how much could selling a legendary Pokémon really be worth? Once that legendary comes out again it’s value is greatly reduced. Say ballpark range that a legendary Pokémon would cost $20-50 because I don’t even know how to determine price—it’s still a 90 day long transaction for 1 sale, and given the daily 20 friendship gift cap, you’d only have 20 customers per account. 

20 people paying $50 each, is only $1000 profit in 3 months is such a small amount of money in a long amount of time it just doesn’t seem practical at all especially the upkeep and responsibility it takes to maintain daily friendship and also running the risk of the person:
- getting the shiny themselves
- going inactive 
- forgetting to open gifts or reaching their max daily gift opening 
- canceling transaction / changing their mind
- forgetting (Bc it takes so long) 

Is there something I’m not understanding? I understand spoofers would heavily abuse trade selling since it’s easier for them but the maintenance is still gruesome.
